skipProbes.trigger-strings: MK3 parseTriggerStrings keys are type-qualified ({type}:{lib}_{id}, Grammar:, ParamValue:) to stop cross-type ID collisions; the raw map is not MK2-shaped. The localization overlay is compared through sax-read with TriggerStrings.
skipProbes.g2t: MK3 G2T (galaxy-conversion service) was reworked against the SC2 Editor oracle and requires/uses dependency libraries; MK2 convertGalaxyToTriggerLibrary without NativeLib refuses or reconstructs 0 elements on the installed corpus. Needs owner disposition and a NativeLib corpus.
skipProbes.export.convert: MK3 T2G requires dependency TriggerData for cross-library references (throws 'Trigger reference cannot be resolved in the loaded libraries'); MK2 degraded to fallback names without NativeLib. 12 of 16 installed cases refuse on MK3 only. Needs a NativeLib corpus (CASC) and an owner decision on the removed fallback.

validateMk2FalsePositives.rule: MK2 validateLibraryStructure reports Comment references as missing (MK2 does not model Comment elements) and flags Params reachable only through them as orphans; MK3 models Comment/CustomScript and reports no finding.

libraryNameNonHexId.rule: MK2 parseTriggerStrings accepts Library/Name/<id> only for hexadecimal ids, so non-hex library ids (ARMP, AREX) get no library name; MK3 applies the name.
